terminal_reason: Fixed and tested on the #14101 branch before merge: named constant _MONITOR_CANDLE_FETCH_LIMIT=220 replaces the shared monitor fetch limit=200, window-unfilled path now logs instead of silently no-opping, and a new test (test_real_shaped_monitor_frame_can_still_fire_after_the_drop) proves the lever can still fire post-drop rather than just not crashing. 90+ existing tests re-verified green.
what: [strategy][bug-fix] Confirmed and fixed PI-20260929-VOLSKIP-0002 (lane VOLSKIP-FORMING's finding, relayed via manager session_01HYq6XtfesZ57VyaQrK6CL1): #14101's drop_forming_bar fix in src/runtime/trail_vol.py, correct on its own, made the vol_trail lever PERMANENTLY, SILENTLY inert once live -- the monitor fetches candles via src.main._build_monitor_ohlcv_fetcher at exactly limit=200, the same as the default vol_pctl_window, so dropping one forming bar leaves 199 closed bars, always < 200, on every single tick. FIX (same #14101 branch, before merge): (1) src/main.py -- named constant _MONITOR_CANDLE_FETCH_LIMIT=220 (20-bar margin above the 200-bar default window), replacing the hardcoded limit=200 in the one shared _fetch closure every strategy monitor tick uses. (2) src/runtime/trail_vol.py -- the window-unfilled path now logs (logger.info, "trail_vol: window unfilled...") instead of a silent no-op, so a future insufficient-margin case is discoverable rather than invisible. (3) tests/test_monitor_ohlcv_fetcher.py updated to assert against the named constant rather than a hardcoded 200. (4) tests/test_trail_vol_live.py gained test_real_shaped_monitor_frame_can_still_fire_after_the_drop, which builds a frame shaped exactly like the live monitor's real fetch (imports src.main._MONITOR_CANDLE_FETCH_LIMIT directly, asserts limit > WIN as a guard against the same regression) and proves the lever can still fire after the drop, not just that it does not crash. 90+ existing tests across the trend/pullback/vol-trail suites re-verified green (no behavior change for any other lever or strategy from the fetch-limit bump).
